This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Ctrl+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
#volcano plot of new drdd data, colored by if up or down in ben's data

WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311 <- read_excel("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/Grad/RNA seq data/WT vs drdd 21dpg 202311.xlsx")
df <- WT_vs_drdd_21dpg_202311

title <- "21dpg colored by ben DEG_take2"

p <- ggplot(data=df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=lg10, col=in_ben))+
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#0377bd", "grey", "#c62828")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab("-log10(p value)") +
  ggtitle(title)
  

p + theme_classic()

#ggsave(paste("DEGs WT vs drdd", title, ".png"), width=3.77, height=3.9)



```
